# 洞玄靈寶玄門大義

**ID:** KR5e0026
**Custom ID:** ZB5e0026

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Dòngxuán Língbǎo Great Purport of the Mysterious Gate*

Anonymous; Táng (7th century)

An early-Táng **systematic doctrinal treatise** on Daoist teachings — an important precursor / source for Mèng Ānpái's later **Dào jiào yì shū** ([KR5e0031](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5e/KR5e0031)). Preserved as **DZ 1124** / CT 1124 (Tài píng bù 太平部).

**Dating.** 7th century. Dynasty: 唐.
